thread:
natalie: quick perms question — we're wiring a logging sink from proj-prod (source) -> bigquery dataset in analytics-prod (dest). Do we need to give the sink service account org-level logging roles, or can this be scoped to the two projects? trying to keep least-privilege and avoid org grants :pray:
ryan: scope to projects only. you should avoid org roles if possible. sink writer identity just needs logging config write on the source and dataset writer on the destination.
samir: +1. Practically: on source project give the caller/service account roles/logging.configWriter (or let the sink create it for you). on destination give the sink SA bigquery.dataEditor on the dataset (or a custom role limited to table.create/insert).
olivia: how do we find the sink SA again? and do we need iam.serviceAccountUser anywhere? :slight_smile:
ryan: run:
```
# after creating sink
gcloud logging sinks describe SINK_NAME --project=proj-prod --format='value(writerIdentity)'
# returns something like: serviceAccount:service-PROJNUM@gcp-sa-logging.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
That identity needs bigquery permissions in the analytics project. No org role needed.
natalie: thanks. any tips for redaction? we don't want PII flowing to analytics.
samir: filter at the router level is best: use a sink filter to exclude obvious PII signals. e.g. `jsonPayload.username="ssn"` is terrible — better to filter patterns. Also consider a log exclusion or a processing step that redacts before insert.
olivia: for stricter stuff we run a tiny redact-cloudfunction triggered by logs and write to BQ after scrub. bit more ops cost but safer.
jit-access-bot: Access request created — proj-prod:grant roles/logging.configWriter to service account service-123@gcp-sa-logging.iam.gserviceaccount.com for 8h (request id: AR-4021)
ryan: note on least-privilege: avoid giving the sink SA bigquery.admin. prefer dataset-level roles: roles/bigquery.dataEditor on the destination dataset only.
natalie: ok i'm going to create the sink with filter + dataset-scoped role, request approved by jit bot. i'll follow up if we need a redact stage. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
olivia: if you want i can sketch a minimal cloudfunction redactor (strips keys/email/ssn) — ping me after you hit any PII in test export.
samir: also file a tiny runbook in repo ops/runbooks/log-sinks.md with which projects/datasets and the exact roles granted. security will audit that.
natalie: will do. saved all suggestions. closing this thread once done.
